accountDetails.title: Dala i-akhawunti yakho
accountDetails.heading: Dala i-akhawunti yakho
accountDetails.intro: Lokhu kuyadingeka. Qhubeka udale i-akhawunti yakho ku-{{ server_name }}. Ngeke ukwazi ukukushintsha lokhu kamuva.
accountDetails.checking: Kuyahlolwa ukuthi igama lomsebenzisi liyatholakala yini …
accountDetails.errorRequired: Lokhu kuyadingeka. Sicela unikeze igama lomsebenzisi
accountDetails.errorInvalidCharacters: Igama lomsebenzisi alilona iqiniso, sicela usebenzise kuphela {{ allowed_characters }}
redirectConfirm.title: Qhubeka uye ku-akhawunti yakho
redirectConfirm.heading: Qhubeka uye ku-akhawunti yakho
redirectConfirm.trust: Ukuqhubeka kuzonikeza {{ display_url }} ukufinyelela ku-akhawunti yakho.
ssoError.title: Ukufakazela ubuqiniso kwehlulekile
ssoError.heading: Kube nephutha
ssoError.emailLinkHint: Uma ubona leli khasi ngemuva kokuchofoza isixhumanisi osithunyelwe nge-imeyili, qiniseka ukuthi uchofoza isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa kanye kuphela, nokuthi uvula isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa kuklayenti elifanayo ongena ngalo.
ssoError.retryHint: Zama ukungena futhi ku-Pangea Chat futhi uma inkinga iqhubeka sicela uxhumane nomphathi weseva.
authSuccess.title: Impumelelo!
authSuccess.mayClose: Manje usungakwazi ukuvala leli windi bese ubuyela kuhlelo lokusebenza
registrationSuccess.title: Ukuqinisekisa Kuphumelele
registrationSuccess.body: Halala! I-imeyili yakho isiqinisekisiwe. Sicela ubuyele kuhlelo lokusebenza ukuze ungene!
passwordResetConfirm.title: Ukuqinisekisa ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi
passwordResetConfirm.intro: Ucele ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yakho ye-Pangea Chat. Chofoza isixhumanisi esingezansi ukuze uqinisekise lesi senzo.
passwordResetConfirm.disclaimer: Uma ubungahlosile ukwenza lokhu, sicela uvale leli khasi futhi iphasiwedi yakho ngeke ishintshwe.
